note: The getomni schema normalises this page into fourteen tidy values — ISO dates, numeric rent, party names and addresses — which quietly throws away the two things that make a filled-in lease form hard: how the term is actually written on the page (a day number and a 'Month Year' phrase in four separate blanks, not an ISO range), and the checkbox block. Extended with the document title, the premises state, the term blanks as written, the printed dollar figures alongside the handwritten ones, the instalment due day, the whole Options to Renew block including both checkbox states and the three blank renewal fields, and the form footer. All fourteen dataset values are preserved unchanged. Every added value corroborated by 8-14 of the 14 saved engine outputs. Judgement calls: (1) both renewal checkboxes are ticked on the page, even though the heading says 'Check one'. Six engines report both, several report only the first, and several report neither — so 'renewalNotAllowedChecked' and 'renewalAllowedChecked' are both true, and an engine that silently resolves the contradiction to one box is wrong. (2) The three renewal blanks (periods, years, months) are printed and empty, so they are null; they exist to catch engines that invent plausible numbers. (3) The form template repeats the 'day of ____' blank twice for both the commencement and the expiry, and both copies are filled with the same value; each is recorded once as 'commencementMonthYear' / 'expirationMonthYear' rather than duplicated. (4) The base-rent paragraph contains a template glitch — 'is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the' appears twice — and is not reproduced verbatim; only the extractable instalment due day is kept. (5) Fields added inside an existing dataset object are listed in field_provenance with dotted paths, so the split between dataset and model values stays visible at sub-key level.

date.description: Date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

monthlyAmountPrinted.description: Monthly rent as pre-printed in parentheses, with currency symbol

securityDepositPrinted.description: Security deposit as pre-printed in parentheses, with currency symbol

instalmentDueDay.description: Day of the month each instalment falls due, as printed

endDate.description: End date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

startDate.description: Start date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

commencementDay.description: Day number written in the commencement blank

commencementMonthYear.description: Month and year written in the commencement blank

expirationDay.description: Day number written in the expiry blank

expirationMonthYear.description: Month and year written in the expiry blank

state.description: State named in the premises clause

optionsToRenew.description: Section 4 checkbox block, recorded exactly as ticked on the page

renewalNotAllowedChecked.description: State of the 'Lessee may not renew the Lease.' box

renewalAllowedChecked.description: State of the 'The Lessee may have the right to renew...' box

noticeDays.description: Minimum written notice before expiry, as printed
